m110001.――おや、これは予想以上では……？: ――Well now, this is more than I expected…?
m110001.――ここが英傑の塔じゃな？\n目の前に見えるのは異界の門かのう。: ――So this is the Heroic Tower, huh? What we see before us must be a gate to another world.
m110001.――ふふふ、ようこそ英傑の塔へ。: ――Heh heh, welcome to the Heroic Tower.
m110001.――まさかあれは、皇帝陛下！？\nそれに王子殿下の幻まで……！: No way… is that the Emperor?! And even an illusion of the Prince…!
m110001.――塔の階層を制したご褒美に、\n「英傑結晶」をあげちゃいます。: —as a reward for conquering the tower's floors, I'll give you a "Heroic Crystal."
m110001.――失礼します。\n少しお時間頂いても宜しいでしょうか。\n王子にご紹介したい方:
――Excuse me.
May I have a moment of your time?
There's someone I'd like to introduce to the Prince—
m110001.――戯れが過ぎるのではありませんか？\nソラス様が王子に試練を課したと聞いて来ま: Isn't this getting a bit frivolous? I heard Solais-san set a trial for the Prince, but now's not the time for a little test of strength…
m110001.――王子君、あなたのご先祖さま、\nそして私達の仲間であった英雄王なんですよ。:
—Prince, it's your ancestor, 
and the Hero King who was also our comrade.
m110001.――簡単なことです。\n千年戦争の終結から幾星霜。\n私は長い時を、この塔の封印: ――It's simple. Since the end of the Millennium War, countless ages have passed. I spent those long years sealed within this tower.
m110001.――英傑の塔は、\n２０層が最上階だと思っていましたが……。: I always thought the Tower of Heroes topped out at the 20th floor…
m110001.……いつの間にこんな塔が？\nこの場所に、こんな建築物はなかったはずですが……。:
…When did this tower appear?
There shouldn't have been any such structure here before….
m110001.……かつての、敵？\nソラス殿、何故\n白の帝国と王国の関係を知っているのでしょ: …Former enemies? Solais-dono, why do you know about the relationship between the White Empire and the Kingdom?
m110001.……これは、過酷ですね。\nまさかこれまでの戦いの情報まで、\nソラス殿に収集さ: …That's harsh. I never imagined you'd have collected all the battle data…
m110001.……コホン。\n王子、ソラスさんの身元に間違いはないようです。\n先程シャディア:
…Ahem.
Prince, it seems Solais's identity is correct.
Shadia just confirmed it a moment ago.
m110001.……王子達の力が及ばぬなら、\nここであなたが彼らを蹴散らし、\nこの世界を諦め: …If the Prince and his allies can't reach that level, you'll drive them away and tell the world to give up?
m110001.あ、ちょっとうれしそうですね。\nほっぺが緩んでますよ？: Ah, you look a bit happy. Your cheeks are all relaxed.
m110001.あなたがあの人の\n――英雄王の子孫、王子君ですね？:
You must be that person—
the descendant of the Hero King, Prince?
m110001.あの英雄王の力を持ってしても、\nそれでも届かなかった魔王討伐……。: Even the Hero King's power couldn't bring the Demon King down…
m110001.あらあら、ここで諦めても良いのですよ？: Oh dear, you could give up right here if you like.
m110001.いつの間にそんな施設を……。\nえぇと、つまり力を証明することで、\nあなたが魔: Since when did we have a place like that…? So, by proving our strength, you'll help us defeat the Demon King?
m110001.えぇ。遠い昔に私が魔術で作り出した塔で、\n魔王と戦わんとする者のためのものです:
Yes. A tower I created with magic ages ago, meant for those who would battle the Demon King.
I think it'll be of great help to you, Prince.
m110001.えーけつけっしょう……？\nえぇと、それはいったい……？: Huh, a heroic crystal…? Wait, what exactly is that?
m110001.おぉ、ソーマちゃん興味津々ですか？\nふふふ、この塔はかつて魔王を封印せし折に、:
Oh, Soma-chan, you're curious, huh?
Hehehe, this tower was built when we sealed the Demon King, at the Hero King's request, and I constructed it.
m110001.けれど、ひとまずは休息を。\n戦士には戦うだけでなく、休むことも必要ですからね？: But for now, take a rest. A warrior needs to rest as well as fight, you know?
m110001.けれど、もし『魔王以上の脅威』が迫ったなら……。\nそんな時に備えて、塔が最適な: But if a threat greater than the Demon King appears… I prepared the tower to self-replicate into the optimal form for such a situation.
m110001.この中には、階層のひとつひとつに、\n英雄の力をはかる様々な試練が用意されている: Within, each floor holds various trials to measure a hero's power.
m110001.これは、英雄王の戦友たる私からの、\n当代の英雄への挑戦――と思っていただければ: Consider this a challenge from me, a comrade of the Hero King, to the heroes of this age.
m110001.さて、それは王子君たちの実力次第♪\nそのための英傑の塔、というわけですからね。: Well then, that all depends on your abilities, Prince-kun. That's why we have the Heroic Tower, after all.
m110001.さて。ここは王子君を鍛錬するための場所ですから、\n私としても手加減することはで: Now then. This place exists to train you, Prince-kun, so I won't hold back. If you're going to give up, now's the time.
m110001.そう、この塔は世界の危機を退けうる、\n英雄を鍛え上げ、\n力を与えるための装置: Indeed, this tower is a device to forge heroes capable of repelling world crises, granting them power.
m110001.そうして純粋な力や、様々な状況に\n対処する柔軟性を見せてくれたなら――: And if you demonstrate pure strength and the flexibility to handle all sorts of situations—
m110001.そうそう。その光に触れている間は、\n特別な加護を受けることができますよ。\n上: Ah, right. While you're touching that light, you'll receive a special blessing. Use it wisely.
m110001.それでは、どうぞ、英傑の塔へ――。: Then, go forth—into the Heroic Tower.
m110001.それでは王子君、これまでの戦いの道程と、\n自分と、それに匹敵する好敵手の映し身: Then, Prince, confront the path of battles you've walked and the mirror image of a worthy opponent equal to yourself. Defeat it splendidly…!
m110001.それでは２１層の試練を起動しますよ！\n王子君、戦闘準備をお願いします！: Then I'll activate the trial of the 21st floor! Prince, prepare for battle!
m110001.ですからまずは、その過程で収集した情報から、\n最初の試練を与えることにしましょ: So first, based on the information we've gathered, let's give you the initial trial. You'll be facing—
m110001.でもこれだけでは物足りませんよね……。\nここはひとつ、天使に、デーモンに……。: But that alone isn't enough, is it… Let's throw in an angel, a demon… —that'll do♪
m110001.どんな助力かはお楽しみに、ですけどね。\n何しろ私も、まだ半信半疑なのです。: What kind of help, you'll have to wait and see. After all, I'm still half-skeptical myself.
m110001.なるほど……。\nその階層を乗り越えていくことで、\n英雄としての強さを示す……:
I see…
By overcoming each floor, we demonstrate our strength as heroes… is that right?
m110001.なるほど……。\nならば、この塔に入る資格があると認めましょう。: I see… Then I'll acknowledge that you have earned the right to enter this tower.
m110001.なるほどな……。\nあいつが王子を助けようとしてくれてるってことか。: I see… so he's trying to help you, Prince.
m110001.なれば、王子君達に\nその実力の片鱗だけでも見いだせなければ、\nここで諦めるよ: So if we can glimpse even a fraction of that power in you, Prince-kun, it's our duty as predecessors to guide you—perhaps even to tell you to give up here if you can't.
m110001.はい♪ お人好しはご先祖様譲りですね、王子君♪: Yes♪ Kindness runs in your blood, Prince.
m110001.ふふ、その時のアンナちゃん良い反応でしたね。\nそれに引き換え王子君は、\nうー:
Heh, Anna-chan gave a good reaction back then.
In contrast, Prince, you seem… hmm? Not flustered at all….
m110001.ふふ、それは私が隠していたからですね。\n何しろ真なる英雄以外が、\nこの塔に迷:
Heh, that's because I kept it hidden.
After all, if anyone but a true hero wanders into this tower, it would be disastrous….
m110001.ふふ、やはり。\nあなたなら、かの魔王を\n滅ぼすことがかなうかもしれませんね。: Heh, just as I thought. You might actually be able to bring down that Demon King.
m110001.ふふ、ケイティちゃんも飲み込みが早い！\nちょうど良い機会なので、\n英傑の塔の: Heh, Katie-chan, you catch on quickly! Since the timing is perfect, let me explain the tower's special mechanisms.
m110001.ふふふ、かつての敵からも信頼が厚いとは、\nそういうところもあの人にそっくりです: Heh heh, even former enemies trust you so much—just like that person, you see.
m110001.ふふふ、さすがに塔が\n自分でそこまで判断はしませんよ♪: Heh heh, even the tower won't make such a judgment on its own♪
m110001.ふふふ。お見事！\nこの階層は制覇されました。: Heh heh. Well done! This floor is cleared.
m110001.ふむ……。\n塔に入るには相応の実力を見せよ、というわけじゃな。\n王子よ、油断: Hmm… To enter, you'll need to show appropriate strength. Don't let your guard down, Prince.
m110001.ふん、上等だ。\nさぁ王子、英雄王にお前の実力を見せてやろうぜ！: Hmph, fine enough. Come on, Prince, let's show the Hero King what you've got!
m110001.まぁ、新しい修行の場が増えるのは良いことだけどな。\nそれより、塔なんかに\nお: Well, more training grounds can't be bad. Still, I don't like being told I'm not strong enough for a tower.
m110001.まずは王子君と、王子君が信じる仲間達が、\nこの塔に入るだけの資格があるかどうか: First, Prince-kun and the comrades you trust must prove they're worthy of entering this tower. My guardians and I will see if you qualify.
m110001.もちろん、\n★の獲得数もスコアの評価対象になりますからね？: Of course, the number of ★ you earn also counts toward your score, you know?
m110001.よく来ましたね王子君。\nここが英雄たる者の器を試し、\n応えた者には更なる力を:
Well done arriving, Prince.
This is the Tower of Heroes, where a true hero's mettle is tested, and those who answer are granted greater power.
m110001.よろしい。\n狭間より現れる守護者と、私の魔術。\n見事退け、実力を見せてくださ: Very well. Face the guardians that emerge from the void and my own sorcery. Defeat us and show your true power!
m110001.わぁ……足場が浮いています……！\n魔界とも物質界とも違う、不思議な感じです……: Wow… the ground is floating! It feels strange—like neither the demon realm nor the material world.
m110001.シャディアちゃんは相変わらず心配性ですねぇ。\n何も自分の興味本位で、\nこんな: Shadia-chan, you're as worry-prone as ever. It wasn't my personal curiosity that led to building this tower, you know?
m110001.ワシらを見くびっては困る。\nこれより過酷な戦場はいくつもあったぞい。: Don't underestimate us. There are far harsher battlefields ahead.
m110001.今の私達では、天界の異変に対抗できないと……。\nそれで突然、２１層に続く階段が: With our current strength we can't counter the celestial disturbance… So a staircase suddenly appeared leading to the 21st floor?
m110001.何とも不思議な術です……。\n……おや？\nソラス殿、あの中央で光輝いているもの: What a bizarre technique… …Hmm? Solais, what's that glowing thing in the center?
m110001.冷静なところは、あの人そっくりですね。\nまぁそれはさておき、私がここへ来たのは:
Your composure is just like that person's.
Anyway, I'm here to guide you to the “Tower of Heroes”.
m110001.名前はあくまで、私がつけた仮のものですけどね。\nその正体は、いわば\n実力を示: The name's just a placeholder I came up with. Think of it as a certificate that proves your abilities.
m110001.塔が起動するまで身動きは取れませんでしたが、\nずっと、この世界を見守り続けてい: I was unable to move until the tower awakened, but I kept watching over this world—and the conflict between your two nations.
m110001.塔の試練を乗り越えたことを証明できれば、\n「英傑結晶交換所」で\n色々な報酬と: If you can prove you've cleared the tower's trials, you can trade it at the "Heroic Crystal Exchange" for all sorts of rewards.
m110001.王子君が、英雄王に匹敵する器なのかどうか。\n魔王を征し、物質界を守護する英雄足: Whether the Prince is truly worthy of matching the Hero King, and whether he can become a hero who subdues the Demon King and protects the material world.
m110001.異界の門を知っているなんて、\n当代の魔術師も捨てたものではなさそうですね。\n: Knowing about a gate to another world, huh? Even today's magi aren't without their tricks. In a way, it's similar—a liminal space connecting elsewhere.
m110001.私はソラス。\n英雄王と共に、かつて魔王を討伐した者のひとりです。:
I am Solais.
I was one of those who, alongside the Hero King, once defeated the Demon King.
m110001.私は彼の未来を想う願いを再現できるように、\nこの塔を設計したに過ぎませんからね: I only designed this tower so I could bring his wish for the future to life!
m110001.私もそのつもりでしたよ？\n２０層まで上り詰めれば、魔王ガリウスに\n対抗できる: I thought the same. I figured reaching the 20th floor would give us the power to stand against the Demon King Garius.
m110001.私達も、あの魔王を真に滅ぼすことは出来ませんでした。\nただアイギス様のお力を借: We couldn't truly defeat that Demon King ourselves. All we did was, with Aegis-san's help, temporarily seal him and push the problem into the future.
m110001.興味がありましたら、\nいつでも「英傑の塔」にいらしてください。\nふふ、王子君:
If you're interested, feel free to come to the Tower of Heroes anytime.
Heh, with your strength, it shouldn't be a problem.
m110001.英傑の塔の意思というべきもの。\n次代の英雄にあらゆる智慧と武技を授けんと、\n: You could call it the will of the Tower of Heroes. It wove a management magic to grant future heroes all wisdom and martial skill, encouraging their growth—
m110001.試練に臨む場合、\n出撃する人数、消費するコストが少ないほど、\nクリア時に記録: When you take on a trial, the fewer people you send out and the lower the cost you spend, the higher your "score" will be recorded upon clearing it.
m110001.諦めるなど……。\n我ら帝国が実力を認めた王子は、\nこんな所で引き返すような器: Give up? The Prince whom our Empire has recognized for his strength is not one to turn back now.
m110001.迷い込んだら、大変……？\nいったい中に何があるというのですか？: Wander in and it would be disastrous…? What exactly lies inside?
m110001.魔法都市に似ているような気もしますけど、\n見たことのない構造物ばかりです……。: It reminds me of a magical city, but everything here is unlike anything I've ever seen…

m200260.ありがとう、エイミーちゃん。\nこの銃、しばらく借りるわね。: Thanks, Amy-chan. I'll borrow this gun for a while.
m200260.いえ、こちらこそありがとうございました！\n温かいお風呂をいただいたばかりか、\: No, thank *you*! Not only did you give us a warm bath, but a delicious meal as well—I'm truly grateful!
m200260.いわば、クラリス殿は事態の中心にいたのだ。\n核心の地に現れたのも仕方があるまい: In other words, Claris was at the heart of it all. It's no surprise she appeared at the core.
m200260.ううん、私も行くわ。\nこの世界にはさっきみたいな魔物がいるんでしょ？\nだった: No, I'll go too. There are monsters like that in this world, right? I want to help however I can.
m200260.えっと……質問なんですけど、\n世界を越えて共鳴しちゃうほど、\n私の魔術って凄:
Um… I have a question.
Since my magic resonated across worlds, does that mean it's that powerful?
m200260.この世界には、たびたび別の世界から\n迷い込まれる方がいらっしゃいます。: People often get lost here from other worlds.
m200260.さあ、話は終わりだ。\n旅人たちよ、門をくぐり元の世界に戻るがいい。:
Now the story ends.
Travelers, step through the gate and return to your world.
m200260.そっか……。\n私、別の世界に飛ばされちゃったんだ……。: I see… I've been whisked away to another world…
m200260.それじゃあ王子、\n一緒にクラリスを探しに行きましょう！: Then, Prince, let's go find Claris together!
m200260.ちなみに、先ほど伺った話によると、\nクラリスさんという方も一緒にいたんですよね: By the way, you said someone named Claris was with you, correct?
m200260.でしたら、その方も\nこちらの世界に飛ばされている可能性が高いです。: If that's the case, she's probably also been sent here.
m200260.では、答えよう。\n答えは「否」だ。:
Then I'll answer.
The answer is “no.”
m200260.はい……。\n皆さん、本当にありがとうございました！:
Alright…
Everyone, thank you so much!
m200260.はい、見ました！ ハッキリと！\n小町さんに使ってもらえるなら、\nその銃も喜ぶ: Yes, I saw! Clearly! If you let me use it, the gun will be thrilled!
m200260.はい。\nですから、小町さんも、きっと元の世界に戻れます。: Yes. So you'll be able to go back, too.
m200260.みなさん、今回は本当にありがとうございました。: Everyone, thank you so much for everything this time.
m200260.アンナさんたちは、こういうの初めてじゃないんだ……。\nちょっとホッとするかも。: So you're not the first… That's a bit of a relief. Everyone who's come before has been able to return, right?
m200260.クラリス殿の魔術とダークエルフの魔術。\nこの二つが世界を越えて共鳴したためダー: Claris's magic and the dark elf's magic resonated across worlds, causing the dark elf's spell to go berserk and sending Claris and the others soaring through worlds.
m200260.助けられっ放しは、性に合わないしね。\nそれに、私の銃の腕はさっき見てくれたでし: Being rescued all the time isn't my style. Besides, you saw how good I am with a gun earlier, didn't you?
m200260.君の魔術が『そよ風』のようなものであったからこそ、\nただ門を開ける鍵になり得た:
Because your magic was more like a gentle breeze, it could only serve as the key to open the gate.
That, in its own way, was a fortunate turn of events.
m200260.君の魔術がダークエルフの魔術に匹敵するものであれば、\nダークエルフの村も、君の: If your magic had been on par with the dark elf's, both the dark-elf village and your body would have vanished.
m200260.小町さんがいた場所の近くにいる可能性もありますので、\nこれから探しに行こうと思: She might be nearby where you were, so we'll go look for her. You just rest here for now.
m200260.小町さんもその、先ほど伺ったデルーガ？\nという怪物との戦闘中に、\nこちらの世: It looks like you were thrown into our world during that battle with the monster Deluga you mentioned earlier.
m200260.最初に出会ったのがダークエルフだった私は、\n全然良くなかったですけど！: I first ran into a dark elf, and that was… not great at all!
m200260.本当にお世話になったわね。\nこの世界に来て最初に出会った人が、\nあなたたちで: You really took care of us. I'm glad the first people I met in this world were you.
m200260.私も、小町さんたちに出会えて良かったです！: I feel the same—I'm glad I met you all, Komachi-san!
m200260.答えを聞きたいかね？: You want to hear the answer?

m200384.――あ、あなたたち！\nこっちには前チャンプ、アナトリア様がいるんですよ！？\n: —Ah, you there! Over here we have the former champion, Lady Anatolia! At the very least, let's try to negotiate—
m200384.――あ、あれ？\nあの雪上部隊って、帝国軍とは違うよね……。\nベラート伯爵の紋: ——Huh? That snow-troop isn't Imperial, is it? They're bearing Count Berault's crest…
m200384.――あえて、帝国の布陣が完了するのを待つとは。\n盟友ハイドース殿は、\n奴らに: Segnand —So you actually wait for the Empire's formation to finish? Your ally, Lord Hydos, intends to give them no excuse at all.
m200384.――あれ、その王子殿下と皇帝陛下は？: —Hey, what about that Prince and the Emperor?
m200384.――あれは……大変です！\nもう戦闘が始まりそうですよ！: —That… that's bad! A battle looks about to start!
m200384.――いえ、王国との連携はより強化すべきです。\nこの戦争は、国家同士のものとは\:
—No, we should strengthen our coordination with the Kingdom.
This war is so different from a war between nations that the premise is entirely unlike.
m200384.――いや、いるよ。\n正規軍は忠誠心の高い兵士ばかりだけど、\nそうじゃない連中: —No, there is. The regular troops are loyal, but there are those who aren't, and they exist within the Empire.
m200384.――うぅぅぅ、どうしよ、どうしたらいい？\nボクにできること、何かない！？:
——Uuuuh, what do I do, what should I do?
Is there anything I can do!?
m200384.――えっ、こんな北の僻地まで、\n王国軍が視察に来てるの？: ???: —Huh, the Kingdom's army is scouting all the way out here in this northern backwater?
m200384.――おお、久方ぶりの物質界だ。\nここは白の帝国だな。\nははは、昔もこの辺りま: Ah, it's been ages since I've set foot in the material world. This is the White Empire, huh? Hahaha, I once pushed this far back in the day!
m200384.――おっと、ここにいたか！\nそろそろ戦闘が始まるぜ、\n連中が砦の「城門」に押: —Whoa, there you are! The battle's about to start, they're swarming the fortress's “gate”!
m200384.――おや、皆さんお揃いのようですね。\n女神アダマス様は、先程お眠りになりました: —Well, it seems everyone's here. Goddess Adamas has just fallen asleep.
m200384.――ここが、憎きアダマスを信仰する国、か。: —So this is the nation that worships the hated Adamas.

To think someone who values loyalty above all would stand on that side.

Yes, I will.
Then, predecessor, farewell.

Yes, I agree.
But not now.

Wh-what!? Me?!
The next move the Empire should make, huh…?

m200384.えぇー、マルレーン寝相悪いしなぁ。: Ehh—Marleen, your sleeping habits are terrible.
m200384.えっ……あ、アタシなにかやっちゃったのか……？: Huh… Did I do something wrong…?
m200384.えっ……えぇと、分かった。\nでも砕けた剣なんて、いったい何に使うんだ。:
Eh… um, okay.
But what on earth will we do with a shattered sword?
m200384.お、親父！？ いったいどこから！？: Oh, father!? Where on earth did you come from!?
m200384.おい、それより連中の数の方が問題だ。\nあれはどう見ても正規兵の軍だ。\n部隊単:
Hey, the numbers are the real problem.
Those look like regular troops no matter how you slice it.
Units moving in formation are scary, huh?
m200384.おぉ……アンジェリーネ様。\nご機嫌麗しゅう。: Ah… Lady Angeline. You're in fine spirits.
m200384.おぉ、ありがたい……！\n白の王国を想う者たちよ！ 今は撤退の時だ！:
Oh, thank you…!
Those who cherish the White Kingdom! Now is the time to retreat!
m200384.おぉ、おぉ……！\n我らが先達が、白の王国の戦士たちが……！！: Oh, oh…! Our predecessors, the warriors of the White Kingdom…!!
m200384.おぉ、おぉ、メリュジアナよ。\n実に懐かしいのう。\nさぁ、もっとよく顔を見せて:
Oh, oh, Meliusiana.
It's truly nostalgic.
Now, show us your face a little more.
m200384.おぉ、おぉ、殺人機械の――こほん、\nこれは失礼な呼び名ですな。\nルイン嬢、ご: Oh, oh, “murder machine”—ahem—what a rude nickname. Miss Ruin, glad to see you in fine health.
m200384.おぉ、おぉ！\n先代、再びお会いできる日が来るとは……！！: Oh! Oh! To think the previous generation would return…!!
m200384.おぉ、おぉ！ 兵たちよ、見よ！\n伯爵殿が最前線に、我らと共に立つぞ！: Oh, oh! Soldiers, look! The Count leads the front, standing with us!
m200384.おぉ、セグナンド殿。\nはて……どうでしょうな……。: Ah, Lord Segnand. Hmm… I wonder…
m200384.おぉ、ハイドース殿。\nお見苦しいところを見せてしまいましたな。: Ah, Lord Hydros. I've shown you a sorry sight, haven't I?
m200384.おぉおぉ、ここから見えるだけでも\nなかなかの大軍勢だ。: Whoa, just seeing it from here—what a massive army.
m200384.おお、ハイドース様の小間使いか。\nワシらの戦いぶり、どうかあの御方に伝えてくれ:
Ah, a servant of Lord Haidos, huh?
Tell that one how we fought.
m200384.おっけーまかせて。\nはぁ、穴埋め大変だなぁ！\nさっそくいってきまーす！: Got it, leave it to me. Phew, filling the gaps is tough! I'm off right away!
m200384.おっと、それは違うぞ陛下。\nサザンカは決して、帝国のためには戦っていない。: Hold on, that's not right, Your Highness. Sasanqua never fought for the Empire's sake.
m200384.おふたりは、強すぎます。\nですが私とて、黒き竜人族の長。\n――この血に恥じぬ: You two are far too strong. Still, I am also the chief of the black draconians—let us fight in a way that does no shame to this blood.
m200384.おまかせあれ。\n私の王子様を呼んでこよう♪:
Consider it done.
I'll go summon my Prince♪
m200384.おや、お褒めに預かり恐悦至極。\n今の喜びをパーセントで表そうか？:
Oh, I'm deeply honored by your praise.
Shall I express my current joy in percentages?
m200384.おやアブグルント。……前線による、かな。\n総じて言えばこちらの方が押されている:
Oh, Abgrund… It's about the frontline, I suppose.
Overall we're being pressed, but that's part of the plan.
m200384.お久しぶりです、墓守のリッチさん。\nお騒がせしてすみません。: Long time no see, Lich, the tomb keeper. Sorry for the disturbance.
m200384.お前が望むのなら、我はお前にも、\n帝国に棲まう獣人にも手を差し伸べよう。: If that's what you desire, I'll offer my hand to you, and to the beast-folk living within the Empire.
m200384.かつてこの地を守った戦士たちよ。\n王子、絶対に気を抜かないようにね。:
Warriors who once defended these lands.
Prince, never let your guard down.
m200384.き、騎兵その２……ひひーん……っ！\n皆さん大丈夫ですか！？\n増援部隊、ただい:
C-Cavalry #2… hiiiin…!
Is everyone alright?!
Reinforcement units have just arrived…!
m200384.くっ……なんという力だ……。\nまさかオークでない者に、これ程の使い手がいたとは:
Damn… what power….
I never imagined someone not an Orc could wield such skill.
m200384.くっ……山岳に退いたか！\n陛下、このまま行軍すれば、包囲されるやも――: Damn… they've retreated into the mountains! Your Majesty, if we keep marching like this we'll be surrounded—
m200384.くっ……敵の数が多すぎるか。\n仕方ない、これは切り札だったが……。: Damn… there are too many enemies. Guess I'll have to use my trump card after all…
m200384.けっ……戦士が息子に死を看取られるなんざ、\n全然嬉しくないだろうが……。: Hmph… A warrior having his son watch his death isn't exactly something to rejoice about…
m200384.けれど、ここで力を与えなければ、\nあなた方の信仰に対して不誠実ではありませんか: But if I don't lend my power here, wouldn't that be a betrayal of your faith?
m200384.けれど、この地は創造神が物質界の民に与えたもの。\n神々の争いで、奪い合うような: But this land was given to the material world by the Creator God. It's not something to be seized in the gods' wars.
m200384.こ、この黒炎は……まさか亜神ハイドース様の……？: Th-this black flame… could it be… the divine Haidōs himself…?
m200384.ここで、あなたに立ちはだかる全ての力は、\n人が亜神に抗わんとする、\nその意志:
All the power that stands before you now
was seized by humanity's will to defy a demigod,
the very result of that resolve.
m200384.ここで、己が信徒と共に冥界の黒炎に焼かれるがいい！\n精神体の一欠片まで消え去れ:
Here, be consumed by the black flames of the underworld alongside your followers!
Let even a fragment of your spirit be erased, goddess Adamas—!!
m200384.ここで追撃をすれば、その部隊は残らず返り討ちにあうぞ。\n……今回は、痛み分けだ:
If we chase them now, that unit will be completely wiped out.
…So this time, we share the pain.
m200384.ここは複数の街道の交差点だからね。\n地形的にも、西から帝都へ入るためには、\n: It sits at the crossroads of several roads. Geographically, anyone heading west toward the Imperial Capital has to pass through here.
m200384.ここまでは上手く潜入できましたけど……。\nうぅ、さっきより敵が増えてますし、\: We managed to infiltrate this far… but the enemy numbers have swelled since earlier, and it looks like we can't avoid a fight…
m200384.こちらの兵を展開できる隙間ができたのだから、\nここからは反撃、というわけだよお: Now that we have a gap to deploy our troops, it's time for a counter-attack, my lady.
m200384.こちらの戦力も、随分と失われてしまった。\n此度の戦、勝利したとしても、\n我が: Our forces have been greatly diminished. Even if we win this battle, our lands will suffer a severe blow.
m200384.このためって、いったいどういうことなの！？\nこんな所に大穴開けたって何も……。:
What do you mean “for this”!?
Why dig a massive hole here…
m200384.この地が冥界に最も近い場所である理由、\n数多の戦士が眠る場所である理由、\nそ: The reason this place is closest to the Underworld, the reason countless warriors lie here, and why resentment still swirls…
m200384.この地で、いったい何が……？\n冥界の門が開いた正式な記録は、\n白の帝国にはな: What on earth is happening here…? There should've been no official record of the Underworld Gate opening in the White Empire…
m200384.この戦いは帝国が背負うべきもの。\nされど、民に血を流させるわけにはいかない。: This battle is the empire's burden. But we can't have the people shedding blood.
m200384.この戦は白の帝国の内乱であり、\n同時に亜神との戦いでもある、ということか。\n:
So this battle is a civil war within the White Empire, and at the same time a fight against a demigod, huh.
There's some truth to that, but…
m200384.この砦は帝都に至る街道の、守りの要だ。\n「城門」も強固な防御力を誇っているが、: This fortress is the key defense on the road to the Imperial Capital. The “gate” boasts solid defenses, but even so, nothing's foolproof in battle.
m200384.この都市には、古くから住まう者もいれば、\n航海の果てに住み着いた者たちもいる。: In this city, there are those who have lived here since ancient times, those who settled here after voyages across the seas, and those we have annexed through war.
m200384.こら、無駄口を叩かない。\n周辺警戒を厳となせと言われたばかりだろう？: Hey, stop spouting nonsense. Didn't you just get told to keep a tight watch on the surroundings?
m200384.こらこら、喧嘩は戦闘が終わってからだよレディたち。\nさぁ、襲撃が止まった今の内:
Hey now, the fighting's over before you start bickering, ladies.
Now, while the raid's halted!
Let's hurry and finish resupplying!

m200384.これが起動試験となる。……すまないな。\n――王子、この砲は広範囲を凍結させ、\: This is the activation test. …Sorry about that. —Prince, this cannon freezes a wide area, drastically slowing the enemy's advance. It's a new weapon.
m200384.これなるは、我らが怒り、父祖の怒り、\n虐げられし者たちの声なき怒り。:
Behold, this is our anger, the anger of our ancestors,
the voiceless rage of the oppressed.
m200384.これは……まずいな……。\n王子、気を抜くな――来るぞ！:
This… this is bad…
Prince, don't let your guard down—here it comes!
m200384.これは、故郷を取り戻す戦いだ。\n胸を張って舵を取れ。\nさぁ、今しばらく海上支: This is a battle to reclaim our homeland. Hold your head high and take the helm. Come now, I'll leave the naval support to you for a while longer.
m200384.これは軍と軍の戦い……。\n戦場を知る者同士の争い、ということですね……。: This is army versus army… a clash of those who know the battlefield.

m200384.これより先、我らと志を同じくする、\n数多の戦士たちが同じ道を駆け抜けることとな: From now on, countless warriors who share our resolve will race down the same path.
m200384.これ以上被害が広がる前に、\n奴を戦場に引きずり出すとしよう。: Before the damage spreads any further, we'll drag him onto the battlefield.
m200384.ご無事で何よりです。\nそろそろ冥界軍も\n動き出すでしょうから、危ないところで:
I'm glad you're safe.
The Underworld army will probably start moving soon, so that was a close call.
m200384.ご苦労でした、マルゴット教導隊長。\nあなたが防衛部隊を指揮してくれていたのです: Thank you for your efforts, Commander Margot of the Guidance Corps. You were leading the defense forces, weren't you?
m200384.ご配慮痛み入る。\n――ではまた、冥界にてまみえよう。:
Thank you for your consideration.
—Then, let's meet again in the underworld.
m200384.さぁ、グラティア。\n鍛冶職人であるならば、その本分を全うしなさい。\nあなたが: Come now, Gratia. As a blacksmith, fulfill your duty. What you should wield is a hammer, not doubt.
m200384.さぁ、冥界軍が来るわ。\nみんな、迎撃の準備を！: All right, the Netherworld army is coming. Everyone, get ready to intercept!
m200384.さぁ、戦いはまだ続いているぞ。\n世界を救う王子のその意志、\n王国軍も皆、受け: Come on, the battle's still raging. Let everyone see that the Prince's resolve to save the world lives on in the Kingdom's forces!
m200384.さぁ、戦いはまだ続いているぞ！\n我らは王国軍。\n盟友たる帝国の民を守るため、:
Come on, the battle isn't over yet!
We are the Kingdom's army.
We'll draw our swords to protect our Imperial allies!
m200384.さぁ、疑問が解けたのなら、\nちゃんと周囲を警戒していておくれよ。: Now that your doubts are cleared, keep a close watch on the surroundings.
m200384.さぁ、若者の道を切り開くのは、\n死にゆく老兵の役割だ――まぁ、もう死んでるんだ: Now, it's the dying veteran's role to blaze a path for the youth—well, I'm already dead, though!
m200384.さぁ、行くぞ同胞たちよ。\n――我らの反逆を見せてやれ。: Come, comrades. —Let them witness our rebellion.
m200384.さぁ前を向いて！ 武器を構えて！\nまだ門は破れてない、諦めるには早すぎるんだか:
Come on, face forward! Take up arms!
The gate's not broken yet; it's too early to give up!
m200384.さぁ我が配下たちよ、\n誇りを胸に、立ち上がったオークよ！\n先代勇者たちが開い:
Come now, my subordinates,
hold pride in your hearts, rise up, Orcs!
Now is the time to tear through the bloodways the previous heroes forged!!
m200384.さぁ王子、次の戦闘の準備だ！\nお前も戦士なら、あいつらを受け止めてやりな！: Come on, Prince, get ready for the next battle! If you're a warrior, step up and take them on!
m200384.さぁ竜人族が兵たちよ！\n地上にさらなる穴を開けてやれ！\nもはやこの都市はわし:
Come, dragonfolk soldiers!
Carve another hole in the earth!
This city is ours now!
m200384.さすがは冥界軍、兵力も無尽蔵ですか。: As expected of the Netherworld army, their forces are endless, huh.
m200384.さすがは教導隊長。\nやり口がやらしー。: As expected of the training commander… your tactics are… naughty.
m200384.さっきの、アンジェリーネ様たちの話、聞いてた？\nどちらもこの国のことを考えてる:
Did you hear what Lady Angelene and the others said earlier?
They're both thinking about this country.
So the townsfolk probably won't get hurt.
m200384.さっきも言っただろう。\n私はサザンカを友だと思っているからだとも。\nさぁ、警: Like I said before, I consider you a friend, so keep your guard up. The enemy's assault isn't over yet.
m200384.さて……セグナンドはどう出るか……。\nあの男が、まさか後ろで\n震えているとい: Now then… I wonder how Segnand will act… He wouldn't be trembling behind his back, would he?
m200384.さて、あとはグラティアの処遇だが――: Now, we just need to decide Gratia's fate—
m200384.さて、それを考えるのは戦闘が終わった後だ。\nここで砦が落ちたら何の意味もないか: We'll think about that after the fight. If the fortress falls now, none of this matters.
m200384.さて、な。\n俺も白の帝国も、恨みを買いすぎている。\n今さら誰が殺しに来てもお:
Well then.
I've earned enough hatred for both myself and the White Empire.
At this point, anyone coming to kill us wouldn't be surprising.
m200384.さて、ワシには会わない方がいいヤツがいるからな……。\nさっさと冥界に戻ると――: Now, there's someone I'd rather not meet… I'll be heading back to the Underworld right away—
m200384.さて、戦いの勝敗は誰にも分からないものだからね。\n兵のひとりとしては勝つつもり:
Well, no one can know the outcome of a battle.
As a soldier, I'm fighting with the intention to win.
…If I have any concern, it's Lord Adamas.
m200384.さて王子よ、貴君にはひとつ助言を授けよう。\nセグナンドたちダークエルフにも、\: Now then, Prince, let me give you a piece of advice. Even among Segnand's Dark Elves there are spellcasters called druids.
m200384.さらばじゃ、メリュジアナ。\nエルドラ様と、ハクノカミ様にもよろしく伝えておくれ:
Farewell, Meliusiana.
Give my regards to Lord Elodra and Lord Hakunokami.
m200384.しかし……クロコさま！\nなぜ……何を目的に戦っているのですか！？: But… Croco! Why… what are you fighting for!?
m200384.しかし、これはあくまで帝国の戦争。\n王国の戦力をいつまでも借りるわけにも――:
But this is still the Empire's war.
We can't rely on the Kingdom's forces forever—
m200384.しかし、それは自分のための戦いである。\n誇り高き我ら獣人は、\n誰かのために戦: But this fight is for ourselves. Proud as we beast-folk are, we have the strength to fight not just for others.
m200384.しかし、それゆえに期待しよう。\n神なる竜に連なる戦士よ。\n竜族の雷、この目に: But that's exactly why we should have high hopes. Warriors who follow the divine dragon, let us witness the thunder of the draconic race with our own eyes.
m200384.しかし、陛下……このままでは、あなたが……ッ！！: But, Your Majesty… at this rate, you'll…!!
m200384.しかし私を捜索している間、\n敵部隊の一部をこちらに\n釘付けにしていると思えば: But while they're searching for me, at least they've got a chunk of the enemy forces pinned here.
m200384.せっかくの最新鋭バトルタンクが……！\nくぅぅぅっ、覚えておけ、白の皇帝めッ！！:
Our brand-new battle tank…!
Ugh, remember this, White Emperor!!
m200384.せめて城門は守りきらないとですね。\nあれが破られたら、砦に敵が侵入しちゃいます: At the very least we have to hold the gate. If that falls, the enemy will pour into the fortress.
m200384.そいつは魅力的だ！\n我が王よ、玉座を磨いておいてくださいよ！: Now that's tempting! My king, polish the throne for me!
m200384.そう、だな……。\n皆も少し休んでくれ。\n先は長いが、今日くらいは祝ってもいい: Right… Everyone, take a little rest. The road ahead is long, but we can celebrate today.
m200384.そう、でしたな……。\nそれではセグナンド殿、地上の制圧は任せましたぞ。: Yes, that's right… Then, Lord Segnand, I entrust the ground conquest to you.
m200384.そういうことよ。\nさぁ王子、剣を構えなさい。\nあなたの前に立ちふさがるのは―: That's right. Come on, Prince, draw your sword. Standing in your way… is the legend of the Orcs!!
m200384.そういうわけだ。\n心霊スポットというと聞こえが悪いけど、\nつまりは誰よりも多: That's right. "Haunted spot" sounds ominous, but basically it's a place where more people have died than anywhere else.
m200384.そういうサザンカこそ、\n普段から「鬼こそ最強！」とか叫んでいるじゃないか。: Sasanqua, you're the one who's always shouting “Demons are the strongest!”
m200384.そうか、お前は戦場に出てまだ短かったな。\n戦場における、最強の存在がどんなもの: I see, you haven't been on the battlefield long. Do you know what the strongest presence on a battlefield is?
m200384.そうだね。これは街を守るためだし――って、\nマレブランケ！ 動いたっ！！\n敵:
Right. This is to protect the town——Malebranche! Move!
The enemy fleet just launched a landing craft!!
m200384.そうだッ！ だが追撃してくる者は皆殺しにしろ！\nそうして――次の戦の為に生き残:
That's right! But anyone who pursues us must be slaughtered!
And… survive for the next battle!!
m200384.そうね……。\n門を開くには、膨大な魔力を必要とする。\nハイドース様と言えど何:
Indeed…
Opening a gate requires an enormous amount of magic.
Even Lord Haidos can't keep opening it over and over.
m200384.そうね……相手はただのダークエルフではない、\n冥界と手を結んだ連中よ。: That's right… Our foes aren't just ordinary Dark Elves—they're the ones who've allied with the Underworld.
m200384.そうはいかないのが、人というものなのさ。\n人間は誇りのために、容易く剣を抜くか:
That's the thing about people—they won't let it be.
Humans will draw their swords easily for the sake of pride.
m200384.そう受け取っていただいても結構です。\n私の考えは、また別にありますから。: Feel free to take it that way. My own thoughts are something else entirely.
m200384.そう聞こえたならば謝罪しよう。\nただ、真なる雷を、知っているがゆえな。: If that's how it sounded, I'll apologize. It's just that I know true thunder.

A truly fine warrior.

Ambushes emerging from the mountains…

Prepare to intercept before they get close.

m200384.帝国に住まう、鬼の部族が長よ。\n――貴様に、頼みたいことがある。\n街への侵入: The chief of the demon tribe that dwells within the Empire… I have a request of you. When we allow the city to be breached, I'll need the power of that club of yours.

Now that Imperial morale is low, it's our chance.
Warriors of the Underworld,
seize this fortress and make a foothold to the north!!

The Imperial troops are extremely skilled.

m200384.微弱だけど、物質界のものではない魔力を感じる。\n冥界軍の解析に使えるかもしれな: They're faint, but they emit a magical energy that isn't from this world. They might help us analyze the Netherworld forces, so please pick them up if you see any.

m200384.心配しなくても大丈夫だって。\n王子がさ、いくつの戦場を\n勝ち抜いてきたと思っ: Don't worry, it's fine. The Prince has survived countless battlefields, you know.

m200384.思い返せば、この身体も\n人の子らの力によって取り戻してもらったもの。: Come to think of it, this body was restored thanks to the children of men.

m200384.戦争など、強がりで参戦するものではない。\n誇りと虚勢を取り違えたままでは、\n:

If you keep confusing pride with pretense, a day will come when you can't turn back.

—Exactly, they're like a prince to those guys.

Since the enemy has deployed an air fleet, we'll always be on the back foot.
If only we had air power ourselves…

m200384.敵の総指揮官はハイドース様なのよ？\n冥界の門を開く権限を持っている亜神なのよ？: The enemy's supreme commander is Lord Hydo himself, the demigod who can open the gates of the Netherworld!

—Prince, we don't have much time left,
prepare to withstand the Orcs' massive offensive!!

The enemy isn't just the Underworld folk.
Troops of beastmen are approaching from afar.
m200384.敵部隊に近付かれる前に、\n遠距離からできるだけ戦力を削っておきたいですね……。: Before the enemy gets close, I'd like to whittle down their forces from afar as much as possible…
m200384.時が経てば、黒炎も\n物質界の法則に飲まれて消えていくけれど……。\n手早く炎を: Given time, the black flame will be consumed by the laws of the material world and fade, but it might be safer to disperse the fire quickly.
m200384.暗殺ではなく、戦争を選ぶ以上、\n白の帝国自体に恨みを持つ者なのでしょうか……。:
If we're choosing war over assassination,
then they must bear a grudge against the White Empire itself…
m200384.最初から想定済みだ。\n……悪い想定の方ばかりが当たっているが。: We anticipated that from the start. …Only the worst-case scenarios seem to be playing out.
m200384.最初のダークエルフの襲撃で、\n警備部隊長が負傷してしまいましたので……。: During the initial Dark Elf raid, the head of the guard was wounded, so…
m200384.最前線に出たがりの困った男だが、\n優れた政治手腕なくして、\nあの寄り合い所帯: He's a troublesome man who loves the front lines, but without sharp political skill he couldn't keep that rag-tag group together.
m200384.最強の鬼が、これからも手を貸してあげるよ。\nだから皇帝も王子も、\n絶対に、だ: The strongest demon will keep lending you a hand, so neither the Emperor nor the Prince should ever—ever—lose to anyone!
m200384.最新鋭の兵器なんだろ、帝国式魔導何とかってのは。\n――それがこの砦にあるって、: It's the latest cutting-edge Imperial-style magical weapon, isn't it? —And it's at this fortress, so I figured someone must've leaked that info.
m200384.望みを叶えよう、かつての強者たちよ。\n冥界と物質界の壁を超えるがよい。:
Let your wishes be fulfilled, mighty ones of old.
Cross the barrier between the Underworld and the material world.

m200384.来いッ！\n獣人の誇りがあるのなら！\n言葉で語るな、牙と咆哮で語るが良いッ！！: Come at me! If you have the pride of a beast-folk, don't speak with words—prove it with your fangs and your roar!!

Don't worry, reports say the auxiliary unit has been subdued.
The Empire can still keep fighting.
m200384.欠片は拾い集めたけど、\n女神の魔力が宿っていた武器に、\nその力を取り戻すこと: I've gathered the fragments, but a weapon that once held the goddess's magic can't have its power restored.
m200384.正直に言って、かなりの無理難題だと思いますよ。\nあちらにも正義があることだけが: Honestly, I think it's an almost impossible task. The only small consolation is that they, too, have a sense of justice.
m200384.正面から蹴散らせ。\n彼らもそれを望んでいるはずだ。: Drive them back head-on. They'll want that too.

This battle was aided by the Kingdom.

This battlefield is yours.

you must cherish this world that much.
m200384.武技も、器も優れた男、か。\nそれだけに惜しいな……。:
A man with both skill and bearing, huh.

m200384.殊勝な心がけだな。\nでは、この礼は別の形でするとしよう。\n帝国――いや、白の: Admirable sentiment. Then let's express our thanks in another way. Empire—no, White Kingdom noble Belart.

we'll keep Your Majesty's life.

m200384.然り。これなる黒炎は、盟友ハイドースとの同盟の証。\n周囲一帯を焼き払う、我らが: Indeed. This black flame is a testament to our pact with ally Haidōs. It is our raging fire that will scorch the surrounding lands.
m200384.獣人……？\n冥界軍で、獣人……まさか……。: Beastmen…? Beastmen in the Underworld army… no way…
m200384.獣人たちが、妥協と諦観を捨て去るために。: Lynx —So that beast-people can cast aside compromise…and despair.
m200384.獣人の長、百獣の王者、無冠のチャンピオン……。\n私の信じた最高の勇者……。: The Beast-folk chieftain, the king of beasts, the uncrowned champion… The greatest hero I believed in…
m200384.王国にとって利のある戦争ではないからな。\nそれに、もし勝利したとしても、\n白: It isn't a war that benefits the Kingdom. And even if we win, it doesn't guarantee the White Empire can continue as it is now.
m200384.王国に出向いてくれ。\n帝国の鬼を率いる者として、\n王国の鬼への大使を担っても: Go to the Kingdom. As the one who leads the empire's demons, we want you to serve as ambassador to the Kingdom's demons.
m200384.王国に負担を押し付けるようで\n少々心苦しいですね……。: It feels a bit cruel to dump that burden onto the Kingdom…
m200384.王国の王子よ、私も戦うぞ！\n共にこの戦線を突破し、帝国軍と合流しよう！: Prince of the Kingdom, I'll fight alongside you! Let's break through this front together and link up with the Imperial forces!
m200384.王国軍には、このマレブランケ隊の救出を頼みたい。\n……できるか？: Kingdom forces, we'd like you to rescue Mare Blanc's unit. …Can you do it?
m200384.王子、あたしは裏門を押さえに行く。\nこの正門はあんたの指揮に任せたよ！: Prince, I'm heading to secure the rear gate. I'll leave the main gate under your command!
m200384.王子、ハイドースとの戦いはまだ続きます。\n気を抜かず、警戒を続けていきましょう:
Prince, the fight with Hydos isn't over yet.
Let's stay vigilant and keep our guard up.
m200384.王子、兵の治療を開始しました。\nシノビと弓手で連携し、周辺の索敵も進めています: Prince, I've begun treating the soldiers. The shinobi and archers are coordinating, and we're also advancing our scouting.
m200384.王子、敵が動き始めたようだ。\nどうやらこちらの先手を取りたいようだね。: Prince, the enemy seems to be making a move. Looks like they want to take the initiative.
m200384.王子、敵の増援部隊だ。\nさすがに後詰を用意していたか、冥界軍。: Prince, enemy reinforcements. The Netherworld forces have even prepared a rear guard.
m200384.王子、敵の攻勢が続いています。\n引き続き指揮をお願いします！:
Prince, the enemy's assault continues.
Please keep commanding!
m200384.王子、敵は帝都の周辺に陣を張っている。\n旗持ちのミノタウロスがここからでも見え:
Prince, the enemy has entrenched themselves around the Imperial City.
You should be able to see the flag-bearing Minotaur from here, right?
m200384.王子、気をつけろ。\n敵軍の士気はより高くなるぞ。: Prince, be careful. The enemy's morale will only rise from here.
m200384.王子、港町の防衛部隊も出ているようです。\n協力して戦闘を進めましょう。: Prince, the port town's defense forces have shown up. Let's work together to push the fight forward.
m200384.王子、王国軍も傷の手当が必要だろう。\n得られた時間は長くはないが、\n可能な限: Prince, the kingdom's troops will need medical attention. We don't have much time, so get whatever preparations you can done.
m200384.王子さま！ 気をつけて！！\nクロコのハルバードがまとっているのは、\n古代の雷: Prince! Watch out!! Croco's halberd is channeling something equal to a dragon-breath from an ancient thunder dragon!
m200384.現状では静かなものだ。\n拠点が物質界にない上、\n異種族の居留地を無意味に探る: At present it's quiet. Since their base isn't in the material world, they can't senselessly scout the other-race settlements.
m200384.生きて帰るつもりがないのなら、\n戦士はその、本当の実力というものを発揮する。\: If you don't intend to come back alive, a warrior will show his true strength. Even a rookie can slay the enemy commander.
m200384.申し遅れた、メフィスト団長の部下、マレブランケだ。\n……本当に助かった、この礼:
Sorry for the delay—I'm Malebranche, a subordinate of Director Mephisto.
...You really saved me; I'll be sure to repay this favor.
m200384.異種族が口を挟むことじゃなかったわね。\n人の国家のことは、人が決めていくべきだ: Lynx —It wasn't the place of other races to intervene. A nation's affairs should be decided by its people.
m200384.白の帝国――いや、白の王国というべきか。\n王政時代に領海を守護した、貴族たちの: The White Empire—no, perhaps the White Kingdom. A fleet led by nobles that protected our waters during the monarchic era.
m200384.白の帝国がその清算を終わらせる、\nその長くも短い時間を、\n物質界を狙う亜神た: The demigods targeting the material realm won't wait for the White Empire's long-or-short reckoning.
m200384.白の帝国が瓦解するより早く、\n決着をつけられるかどうか。\nそしてそこに、民を: Whether we can settle this before the White Empire collapses, and whether we can do it without dragging the civilians into it.
m200384.白の帝国が謳う実力主義に、権威など存在しない。\n皇帝の正当性とは、ひとえに先王: In the meritocracy the White Empire boasts, there is no such thing as authority. The emperor's legitimacy rests entirely on the previous king's abdication—that fact is the empire's greatest support.
m200384.白の帝国が限界に達していることなど、\n俺も既に、理解している。: I already understand that the White Empire has reached its limit.
m200384.白の帝国と王国は、かつて敵対していたはず。\n今からでも付け入る余地はあるのでは:
The White Empire and the Kingdom were once enemies.
There might still be a way to exploit that, even now.
m200384.白の帝国に奪われし、父祖の地を取り戻す時が来た！\n狼の民よ、牛の民よ、今こそ先:
The time has come to reclaim the ancestral lands stolen by the White Empire!
Wolf folk, cattle folk, now is the moment to tell our ancestors!
We have come with our own hands to take back our homeland!
m200384.白の帝国は戦力と領土を必要としていた。\nあいつらはその地を守りたかった。\n―: The White Empire needed troops and territory. Those Orcs wanted to protect their land. —And we're here as the Empire's reinforcements.
m200384.白の帝国建国の折、あるいはそれ以前の、\n国を守るための戦いで散っていった、\n: When the White Empire was founded, or even before, the soldiers of the White Kingdom who fell defending the nation are now shouting in the Underworld.
m200384.白の王国を取り戻す、そのためならば、\nこのベラート、己を犠牲にすることすら厭わ: To reclaim the White Kingdom—I, Belart, will even sacrifice myself if that's what it takes!
m200384.白の王国貴族たちの\n無念を代表してここにあるのは確かですが、\nさりとて皇帝の: I may stand here as the voice of the White Kingdom nobles' regret, but that doesn't mean I'm eager to take the Emperor's head…
m200384.白の皇帝は今、生死の狭間にある！\nされど、彼に国を預けた王家の血は、\n今もな: The White Emperor now teeters between life and death! Yet the royal blood that entrusted him with the nation still stands with you on this battlefield!
m200384.皆さん、敵は城門で足止めされています。\n形勢は逆転しました。\nどうか、ご武運: Everyone, the enemy is stalled at the gate. The tide has turned. May fortune favor us!
m200384.皇帝に騎士団長、王国軍まで北方へ向かわせ、\nあえて作り出した弱点にて、\n敵を: The emperor dispatched the Grand Master of the Knights and the kingdom's army north, deliberately creating a weak point so we can crush the enemy like a lump of malice.
m200384.目的……カ……。\nそれヲ知ってどうスル。\nコレヨリ、この地の生命は息絶えルと: Purpose… what for? Knowing that won't change anything. All that matters is that the life here will cease to breathe.
m200384.眠りについたまま、か……。\nでも、最初から三女神を頼るつもりはないでしょう？:
Still asleep, are you…
But you never intended to rely on the Three Goddesses from the start, right?
m200384.知りたくば、次こそ我が命を刈り取るがいい。\nさらばだ、白の皇帝。\n次に見える:
If you want to know, then go ahead and try to take my life next time.
Farewell, White Emperor.
I'll be looking forward to the day we meet again.
m200384.知るか、そんなこと。\nだが親父殿や、先祖代々の勇者たちが待っている。: I don't care about that. But my father and the heroes of my ancestors are waiting.
m200384.砲を収められよ！\nこちらに敵意はありませぬ。: Hold your fire! We bear you no ill will.
m200384.硬きウロコもナク、強大な体躯モ持たぬがユエか。\nソレガ、空をユクことと何の関係: No hard scales, no massive frame—so what does that have to do with soaring through the heavens?
m200384.確かに……。\nあの伯爵であれば、\n真っ先に名乗りをあげそうなものですよね。: Indeed… If it's that count, he'd be the first to announce his presence.
m200384.確かに……。\nでも無理はしないように！\n援軍がきっと来てくれるはずですから！: That would definitely help… but don't overdo it! Reinforcements should arrive soon enough!
m200384.神像では何度も見ている。\n亜神ハイドース、ここで決着をつけるとしよう。:
I've seen you many times in the statues.
Subgod Hydos, let's settle this here.
m200384.神器を、人の手で新たに打ち直したのも――: Reforging the relic with human hands—
m200384.神話以前の物語に謳われる、\n冥界のハイドースが操るという炎……ですか！？: The flame spoken of in pre-mythic tales, the one said to be wielded by the Underworld's Haidōs…?
m200384.私たちの間に入ってくるような兵がいるなら、\nきっと将来有望なことでしょう。\n: If any soldier tries to get between us, they'd surely have great potential. —Now then, shall we begin the counter-offensive?
m200384.私には、どちらが正しいのか分かりませんが……。\nどうかご武運を！: I don't know which side is right… Please, may fortune favor you!
m200384.私は……私たちは……あなたに助けてほしかった。\nでもそれ以上に……故郷のために: I… we… wanted you to help us. But more than that… I wanted you to acknowledge that we are warriors fighting for our homeland.
m200384.私はただ、魔力を与えただけ。\n白の皇帝が命を繋いだのも――:
I only gave it magic.
The White Emperor kept his life going—
m200384.私は善き女王を目指していますから。\n正々堂々、正義に則った戦いでなくては。: I aim to be a good queen. It must be a fair, righteous battle.
m200384.私兵を持つ貴族が、王政の頃からの連中が、\n今の白の帝国にどれだけいると思ってい: Think of how many nobles with private armies from the old monarchy are still around in the White Empire.
m200384.空が、我らオークの味方をしています。\n吹雪が近付いてきました。\n敵の弓矢は狙: The sky's on our side, us Orcs. The blizzard's closing in, making the enemy's arrows hard to aim.
m200384.空を行く、竜人……？\n竜将クロコか！！: Dragon people in the sky…? The Dragon General Croco!!
m200384.窮地に陥った者の救出という面では、\n王国軍以上の経験を積んだ軍は存在しないから: When it comes to rescuing those in dire straits, no army has more experience than the Kingdom's.
m200384.結構だ。\nマレブランケ、王子を呼んできてくれ。\n次の戦闘に備えるぞ！:
That'll do.
Malebranche, go fetch the Prince.
We need to prepare for the next battle!
m200384.総員、剣を構えよ！\n今より反撃の始まりだ！: All troops, ready your swords! The counter-attack begins now!
m200384.総員、後退せよ！ 次の作戦に移るぞ！\n伯爵殿に花道をあけてやれ！:
All troops, retreat! We'll move to the next operation.
Clear a path for the Count!
m200384.聞け！ 白の帝国が兵たちよ！\nこの地に集いし、白の王国を受け継ぐ者たちよ！: Listen, soldiers of the White Empire! You who have gathered on this land, heirs of the White Kingdom!
m200384.臣下が、まだ死ぬなとうるさくてな……。: My lord keeps pestering me not to die yet…
m200384.航空艦隊の移動力が必要な地点への同時攻撃。\n今回は完全に、冥界軍の手のひらの上:
A simultaneous strike on the location that needs fleet mobility.
This time, the Underworld army is completely at our fingertips.
m200384.艦隊を陽動に、ダークエルフがさらに時間を……。\nまさか、次の手があるというのか: Using the fleet as a diversion while the Dark Elves buy more time… Could there be a next move?
m200384.良いだろう、そろそろ本気を見せてやる。\nう、お、お、おおお、おおおおおおおォオ: Very well, it's about time I show you my true power. U-u-u-ooo-ooo-ooooooOOO!!
m200384.英雄王の系譜、その力を借りねば\n帝国の維持も出来ないとは……。\n何が力ある者: The Hero King's lineage… without borrowing that power, we couldn't even keep the Empire together… Who truly wields strength? Who truly is an emperor?
m200384.落ち着いてレーネ。\n慌てるとろくなことないんだから。:
Calm down, Lehne.
Panicking won't help anything.
m200384.蘇っタ……蘇っタノダ……。\n我ラが族長が……大長老が……ッ！！: We've… we've returned! Our chieftain… the Grand Elder…!
m200384.蘇生の術により、我が身は徐々に崩れつつはあるが――\nこの魂砕け散るより前に、帝: The resurrection spell is slowly breaking me down, but before this soul shatters, I'll crush the Empire and all who have pledged to the Kingdom!
m200384.行くぞ諸君！ 祖国のために剣を取れ！\nかの傭兵より、国を取り戻すのだ！！:
Let's go, everyone! Take up your swords for the homeland!
We'll reclaim the country from those mercenaries!!
m200384.街の皆は、誰も死んでない！\n全員守ったんだよ、誇れよ皇帝！: Nobody in the city died! We protected everyone—be proud, Emperor!
m200384.街を包囲する地下道を、\n竜人族が作るまでの時間稼ぎだったんだよ、この戦いは。\:
They're buying time until the Ryujin finish the tunnels that'll encircle the city.
If we keep this up… we'll be surrounded on all sides and crushed!
m200384.西の砦……ふふっ、ならば問題ありませんわ。\n帝国の大動脈たるあの砦は、\n彼の: The western fortress… hehe, then there's no problem. That fortress, the empire's lifeline, is being defended by his troops.
m200384.西の砦に敵獣人の部隊が進軍！\nこちらの増援が間に合わない距離です！: Enemy beastmen are marching on the western fortress! They're too far for our reinforcements to arrive in time!
m200384.見くびってもらっては困る。\n城門なんざワシらの敵じゃないぞ。\nここはひとつ、:
Don't underestimate us.
The gate isn't even our enemy.
We'll just punch a hole through the wall!!
m200384.見たか！ 若ぇの！！\nワシらの子孫の土地を奪った\n白の帝国の土手っ腹に風穴あ: See that, youngster!! We've blown a wind-hole in the White Empire's belly that stole our ancestors' land!!
m200384.見事耐えきるのならば、\nこちらも手段を講じる必要があるだろう。: If you manage to endure splendidly, we'll have to take measures as well.
m200384.覚えているとも！\nだが、それを押してなお、\n我らは未来の子らの為に、平和を願: I haven't forgotten! Yet even so, we still wish for peace—for the children of the future!
m200384.親友置いて逃げるわけないじゃん！\nそれより、急いで戦闘準備を！\n雪上兵はすぐ: I'd never ditch my best friend! Now hurry and get ready for battle! Those snow troops will catch up in no time!
m200384.詭弁は聞き飽きた。\n貴様の本心を引きずり出すには、\nどうやら、敗北を味わわせ:
I've heard enough sophistry.
To draw out your true intentions,
it seems I must make you taste defeat.
m200384.誇りのために、命を捨てることだってある。\nオークとは戦いに生きる種族。\n戦場: Sometimes you have to give up your life for honor. Orcs are a race that lives for battle. Dying on the battlefield—that's glory.
m200384.誘い込んで叩く、というわけね。\n……勝てると思う？:
Luring them in and striking, huh.
…Do you think we can win?
m200384.誰かに助けてもらえるなんて思うなッ！！\n気高き獣人の誇りと、\n卑屈な負けライ: Don't expect anyone to save you!! The noble pride of beast-folk and that pathetic, defeat-loving lion spirit don't belong together!
m200384.調査の手を入れれば、\n冥界軍への関与を疑うことになりますからね。: If we start probing, it'll look like we're meddling with the Underworld forces.
m200384.諦めるな！\nここで耐えなければ、援軍は来ないぞ！！:
Don't give up!
If we don't hold out here, reinforcements won't arrive!!
m200384.貴様か……。\nどうした、ディアスのところにいると思っていたが。: So it's you… What brings you here? I thought you were with Dias.
m200384.貴様がまっさきに裏切ると思っていたのだがな……。\nいったいどんな心境の変化だ？: I figured you'd be the first to betray us… What kind of change of heart is this?
m200384.貴様は……どうしてそちら側に立っている。\n子爵よ、帝国騎士の誇りを忘れたか！: You… why are you siding with them? Count, have you forgotten the pride of an Imperial knight?
m200384.貴様ら、いったい誰に刃を向けたのか分かっているのか！\n古代龍様、黄金竜の姫様は:
You lot, do you even know who you're pointing your blades at!?
The Ancient Dragon, the Golden Dragon Princess—
They're walking side by side with the kingdom!
m200384.軍の仕事が忙しくてね。\nなかなか里帰りもできない……って、\nアタシを薄情者み: Work's been crazy busy, so I can't really go back… Hey, don't call me heartless!
m200384.連中が退いたのは、壊滅したからではない。\nこれ以上の被害拡大を防ぐために退いた:
They didn't retreat because they were annihilated.
They withdrew to prevent further damage.
m200384.連中の目的は時間稼ぎだ。\nその命をかけてまで、仲間のために\nわずかな時間を稼: Their goal is just to buy time. They're willing to risk their lives to buy a few precious moments for their comrades.
m200384.違う……あれはもっと異質な……。\nあたしたちより、古い竜の雷……？: No… that's something far more alien… The lightning of a dragon older than us…?
m200384.避難しろって言われても――あぁもう！\nマルレーンのバカ！\nすぐ危険な場所に飛: Even if you tell me to evacuate… Ugh, you idiot Marleen! You always rush straight into danger!
m200384.部隊として進軍してくる者は、\n散兵よりも耐久力が高くなると予想されます。\n各:
Those advancing as units will likely have higher durability than scattered troops.
Everyone, remember the enemy is an army!
m200384.部隊を撤退させよ、威力偵察は十分だ。\n皆に小休止を取らせ、陣形を整え直すのだ。:
Withdraw the units; we've gathered enough intel on their strength.
Give everyone a short break and reform the lines.
m200384.銀の髪に、黒き外套……。\nおそらくは、ダークエルフを率いる首魁、\nセグナンド: Silver hair, black cloak… It's probably the Dark-elf leader himself, Segnand!
m200384.陛下、こちらも同意見です。\nあえてあちらが有利な、\n平地で迎え撃つ必要もない: Your Highness, I agree. There's no need to deliberately meet them on the plain where they have the advantage.
m200384.陛下、しゃべらないでください！\n早くヒーラーを……っ。\nトゥーダ！ 神官戦士: Your Majesty, don't speak! Send a healer quickly…! Tuda! Call in the priest-warriors!
m200384.陛下、ハイドースは戦場の黒炎を吸収してるんだ！\nめちゃくちゃな魔力をかき集めて:
Your Highness, Hydos is absorbing the battlefield's black flame!
He's gathering an insane amount of magical energy!
m200384.陛下、冥界軍が撤退していきます。\n……おそらくは、今の襲撃は威力偵察だったので: Your Majesty, the Underworld army is withdrawing. …It was probably just a power-reconnaissance raid.
m200384.陛下、各前線より伝令が。\nダークエルフ、オークの部隊により、\n各重要地点が占: Your Majesty, messengers from each front report that Dark Elf and Orc units have occupied the key points.
m200384.陛下、王子殿下、お気をつけを。\n子爵は帝国屈指の武人の家系。\n当主たるあの方:
Your Majesty, Prince, be careful.
The Count comes from the Empire's foremost warrior lineage.
Even the head of that house possesses superb martial skill.
m200384.陛下！ 敵の増援です！\n飛空戦艦がさらに出現！: Your Majesty! Reinforcements have arrived! More airships are appearing!
m200384.陛下！ 東の方角より、飛空船が接近中です！\nそれから、な、なんというのか……。: Your Highness! Airships are approaching from the east! And, uh, what's it called…
m200384.陛下！ 王子！\n警戒すべきは地面の下だよー！！:
Your Highness! Prince!
We need to watch out beneath the ground!
m200384.雪上装備の兵が迫ってるんだ！\n雪の上でも関係なく、高速で突っ込んでくるよ！！: Snow-equipped soldiers are closing in! Even on the snow they'll charge at full speed!!
m200384.領民や、伯爵領の兵にとって見れば、\n私たちこそ悪役だ、ということか……。\nそ: From the perspective of the peasants and his own soldiers, we're the villains… Right, I'll cool my head a bit.
m200384.飛空戦艦も雪山を超えてきます。\nここからは総力戦ですよ！: The sky-ship will cross the snowy mountain. From here it's an all-out battle!
m200384.馬鹿な、どこから兵を――否、将を増員したというのだ。\nまさか本当に、冥界から喚: Ridiculous—so they've increased troops—no, commanders—from somewhere? Could they really have summoned them from the Netherworld!?
m200384.馬鹿者が、ワシらがいつまでも戦っていたら、\nお前たちの戦果を奪ってしまうだろう: Foolish ones, if we kept fighting forever, we'd end up snatching your spoils!
m200384.騎士団長のディアナ？ 神官戦士団長のトゥーダ？\nまさか王国の王子？ ……違うで:
Knight Commander Diana? Cleric-Warrior Commander Tuda?
Surely not the Kingdom's Prince…? …You think otherwise?

Who you are!

it could pull off a trick like this, even if only on a limited scale.

It's precisely because of that wavering

The gods of Takamagahara dreamed of a future where humanity would keep growing,
and that's why they yielded this world to us.
m920219.タカマガハラの神には、建前というものが必要なのだ。\n他の階層よりも、契約を重視:
The gods of Takamagahara need a facade.
We value contracts above all other strata.
m920219.ツクヨミ、物質界の現状は把握しているのでしょう？\nあなたの愛する人類の成長、デ:
Tsukuyomi, you must be aware of the current state of the Material World, yes?
If Dias's scheme succeeds, the growth of the humanity you love
will be lost forever.
m920219.ツクヨミというのは、どんな神さまなんですか？: What kind of deity is Tsukuyomi?
m920219.ツクヨミ様……ですよね？\nお願いします、力を貸してください！:
Tsukuyomi-sama… is that you?
Please, lend us your strength!
m920219.ヌンと王国は協力関係にありますから。\n困っている時に、それを見過ごしたりはしま:
Nun and the kingdom are allied.
We can't just turn a blind eye when you're in trouble.
m920219.ハリンヘイム様、何かありましたか？\nなんというのか、悩んでいるようなお顔を……:
Harinheim-sama, is something the matter?
You look… troubled, somehow.
m920219.プロメ、私はお前ほど、\nすべての人類を信じることはできない。: Prome, I cannot trust all of humanity the way you do.
m920219.ホウ……。\nならばまずは、そのふたりを代表と認めよう。\n名乗れ、勇敢なる人類:
Hm….
Then I shall recognize those two as your representatives.
State your names, brave humans!
m920219.主神の不在を……ヌンにはもはや、\n太陽神がおらぬことを、民に打ち明けたのだ。:
We told the people the truth about the absence of the chief deity…
That Nun no longer has a sun god.
m920219.人の子らは、立派に己の道を選び、\nその両脚で歩み続けている。:
The children of men have chosen their own path with dignity,
and they continue to walk it on their own two feet.
m920219.人の手に余る遺物など、\nいびつな進歩をもたらすだけだ。: Relics beyond human capability would only lead to twisted progress.
m920219.人は人と争うことで、切磋琢磨し、\n次なる時代を築いていくものだ。: People strive against one another, pushing each other to grow, and build the next era.
m920219.人類には、世界を譲ったのだ。\n見事守り抜き、その未来を築き上げよ。:
We have handed the world over to humankind.
Guard it well, and build its future.
m920219.人類にはまだ早い、自分たちのその脚で、\n同じ技術の高みに至るまで待つべきだ、で: That it's still too early for humanity, and we should wait until they can reach the same heights of technology on their own feet, right?
m920219.人類に世界を譲ってなお、\n陽光がないと困るだろうからって\n少しだけ手を貸して:
Even after yielding the world to humanity,
that goddess thought they'd be in trouble
without the sunlight, so she's been lending a little help.
m920219.人類の力、あの月神に見せてやってください。: Show that moon god the strength of humanity.
m920219.今考えてる！\n王子、とにかく距離をとれ！\n雷雲の包囲が完成する前に突破だ！:
I'm thinking!
Prince, put some distance between us and them!
We have to break through before the thundercloud encirclement is complete!
m920219.他のオリュンポスと縁深い地域だって、\nきっと似たようなものだと思うよ？:
I imagine regions with strong ties to Olympus
are in a similar situation.
m920219.何かきっかけがあれば……。\nうーん……あめのいわふね……あめのたぢから、つくよ:
If we can find a trigger for her memories…
Hmm… the Heavenly Rock Ship… the power of the heavens… Tsukuyomi…
Do you remember any names, perhaps?
m920219.何か覚えていないか。\nたとえば……天の磐船がどうとか。:
Is there anything you can recall?
For instance… something about the Heavenly Rock Ship.
m920219.信じてる、信じたいと思っていても、\n心に疑念が生まれるのは止めようがないにゃよ:
Even if you believe, or want to believe,
you can't stop doubts from forming in your heart, nya.
m920219.信仰にわずかな陰りが生まれ、\n夜になり、陽光の加護が弱まると、\n今夜のように:
When even a shadow of doubt creeps into their faith,
and the sun's protection weakens with the coming of night,
undead begin to appear, as they did tonight.
m920219.僕は例外だ。\n――それで、何が条件があるんだろう？:
I'm the exception.
—So, what are the terms?
m920219.先日までは、こんな状況ではなかったと思うのですが……。\nいったい何があったので:
I don't think things were this bad just a few days ago…
What on earth happened?
m920219.前回は――太陽の女神が隠れた時には\nどうやってここを開けたの？: Last time—when the sun goddess hid—how did they open it?
m920219.前線、騎兵隊で突破します！\n付いてきてください！:
I'll break through the front line with the cavalry!
Follow me!
m920219.参ったと言っただろう？\nオレはここを守るため立ちはだかり、敗北した。\nこれで:
I said I was beaten, didn't I?
I stood in your way to guard this place, and I lost.
Now I can let you through without a care.
m920219.同じく、ボウライダーのマーガレットですわ。: Likewise, I am Margaret the Bow Rider.
m920219.君はやたらと頑丈だから経験がないだろうが、\n亜神もまた、ひとつの生物には違いな:
You're unusually durable, so you probably haven't experienced it,
but a demigod is still a living being.
A severe enough shock can wipe out their memories.
m920219.天使部隊で王国軍本隊を殲滅する気とは、\nさすがにテメェらを過大評価しすぎだぜ？:
Planning to wipe out the royal army's main force with just an angel squad?
You've got a bit too high an opinion of yourselves, don't you?
m920219.妨害を確認。\n対象を含め、全域の抹殺を執行します。:
Obstruction confirmed.
Executing total annihilation of the area, including the target.
m920219.子に頼られれば嬉しいものよ。\nさぁ、奥の分からず屋どもも、\nその実力でねじ伏:
It's a joy to be relied upon by one's children.
Now, you stubborn fools in the back,
go on and crush them with your true strength! That's the Doskoi spirit!
m920219.当然だともー。\n星を司る我が彗星の力も加えたからねー。\n星を砕くのはいつだっ:
Naturally~.
I've added the power of my comet, the one that governs the stars~.
After all, it takes the power of stars to shatter them~.
m920219.我らはヌンを守るため、民を守るために、\n嘘に嘘を重ねてきた……。\nそれが歪み:
We have lied upon lie to protect Nun and its people…
But those lies bred distortion, leading to incidents like the one just now.
m920219.断る！ だって、だってこの子は……。: I refuse! Because, because this girl is…….
m920219.昔話に聞いたことがありますな。\n確か千年戦争より昔、\nいつの時代のことかも分: I've heard that tale before. It was a story from before the Millennium War, from an age so distant its era is unclear.
m920219.東の国――あの辺り一帯の大地は、\nオリュンポスの「タカマガハラ」をもとに\n生: The eastern nation—the entire region was created based on Olympus's "Takamagahara."
m920219.物質界は、我らオリュンポスに座する者にとって\n我が子のようなものだぞ？:
The Material World is like our children
to us who sit on the Olympian throne.
m920219.王国軍の者たちならば、\n模擬戦の歓待をきっと喜んでくれると思ったのだが……。\:
I thought the members of the Kingdom's army
would surely appreciate a sparring match as hospitality…
Bastis, you really need to learn more about the human heart—
m920219.王子、包囲されてんぞ。\n総員戦闘準備！ 武器を構えろ！！:
Prince, we're surrounded!
Everyone, prepare for battle! Weapons up!!
m920219.王子、気をつけてください。\nツクヨミはああ言っていますが、\nおそらく手加減す:
Prince, be careful.
Even if Tsukuyomi says that, she likely has no intention of holding back.
m920219.王子よ、なにかと面倒をかけるな。: Prince, do not cause me any more trouble.
m920219.発言は許可されていません。\nその少女を引き渡しなさい。:
Speech is not permitted.
Hand over that girl.
m920219.知性への冒涜だぞ、アキレア。\nとはいえ、この状況では戦わない選択肢はないか。:
That's a blasphemy against intelligence, Achillea.
Still, in this situation, fighting seems to be the only option.
m920219.確か、前にタカマガハラに来た時、\nあまつみかぼし様が言っていました。:
I remember when we visited Takamagahara before,
Ama Tsu Mikaboshi-sama said…
m920219.神に道理を期待するな、胃に穴が開くぞ。: Don't expect gods to reason with you. It'll give you an ulcer.
m920219.神の権能とは、己を律する法と表裏一体。\n契約をたやすく覆すようでは神とは呼べぬ:
A god's authority and the laws that bind it are two sides of the same coin.
A being that overturns a contract so lightly cannot be called a god.
m920219.神の片付けるべき問題を、\n人の手に委ねてしまっているだろう？: You've left a problem meant for the gods to the hands of a human, haven't you?
m920219.神代の遺物は、人類にはまだ早い。\nあれは数千、数万年後に匹敵する技術だろう。\:
Relics from the Age of Gods are still too advanced for humanity.
That technology is on par with what will exist thousands, tens of thousands of years from now.
Honestly, I'm against handing the Heavenly Rock Boat over to humanity.
m920219.移ろう幻影、様々な姿を取るこれらのまやかし。\nおそらく私たちの\n相手をしてく:
Shifting phantoms, taking on all sorts of forms.
I believe the one facing us
is Tsukuyomi.
m920219.良いだろう。\nならば最後に、その実力を我が前にて示せ。:
Very well.
Then, for the last time, show me your true strength.
m920219.要塞宮殿は天界の超高空に存在するもの。\nあの場所に到達するには、\n高度と、世:
The Fortress Palace exists in the uppermost reaches of the Heavens.
To reach that place, you'll need a ship that can break through both the altitude and the walls of the world.
m920219.見守ると、決めたのか。: So you've decided to watch over them?
m920219.記憶のない小娘を殺すために派遣されてきたってか。\n不意打ちで暗殺とは、ちょっと:
So they were sent to kill a girl with no memory.
An ambush assassination… that's a pretty dirty way to do things!
m920219.諸君、戦闘準備だ。\nアメノタヂカラが言っていたとおり、\nここから先は無理やり:
Everyone, prepare for battle.
Just as Ameno Tajikara said,
we'll have to force our way through from here on.
m920219.警備用は常時動いてることに意味があるにゃよ！\n触らなきゃいいだけにゃー！！:
The whole point is that they're always on duty, nya!
Just don't touch them, that's all, nya!!
m920219.超古代文明の飛行能力に、神獣ユニコーンの船体。\nそして天の磐船の持つ超出力機関:
The flight capabilities of a super-ancient civilization, combined with the body of a divine unicorn.
And the super-powerful engine of the Heavenly Rock Boat…
My heart is pounding a little.
m920219.逃げ場がなさすぎる……。\n雷雲をぶち抜くにしても、\n部隊を展開する隙間すらな:
There's no way to escape…….
Even if we try to punch through the thunderclouds,
there's no room to deploy the unit…….
m920219.長い行軍で疲れているだろう？\n今宵はこのヌンにて、\nゆっくり心と身体を休めて:
You must be weary from the long march.
Tonight, please rest your mind and body here at Nun
and take it easy.
m920219.間違っても雷雲の下に向かわせるなよ？\nあの下は落雷だらけだ。\nお前の指揮能力:
And for the love of all that's holy, don't send them under those thunderheads!
It's a lightning storm down there.
Show me what you've got as a commander!
m920219.頭の良さを発揮できる絶好の機会なんだから！\nほら、一緒に叡智でぶん殴りにいくよ:
It's a perfect opportunity to show off my intelligence!
Come on, let's smash through it with wisdom!
Next time we're going even deeper, so it'll be a one-week course!
m920219.（…………あーあ。\n天の磐船、手に入れちゃったのか）:
(…………Ah, damn.
So they've gotten their hands on the Heavenly Iwafune.)
m920219.（……なるほど。\nそれでは、アマツちゃんとお呼びしますね？）:
(……I see.
Then I shall call you Amatsu-chan, shall I?)
m920219.（……ヌンは、前に進んでいるんだ。\n色々な困難に立ち向かいながら）:
(…Nun is moving forward.
Facing all kinds of difficulties)
m920219.（……人が、人の手で己の未来を掴みに行く、か）: (…People, grasping their own future with their own hands, huh)
m920219.（あんなもの手に入れて、\n人類の未来が大丈夫か心配ではあるけど――）:
(I can't help but worry whether humanity's future is safe
with something like that in their possession――)
m920219.（せっかく芽生えた新たな自我だ。\n自身のこととはいえ、上書きするのは忍びない）:
(A new self has finally begun to sprout.
Even if it's my own, I can't bear to overwrite it.)
m920219.（それより大変なのは、要塞宮殿のあいつらか。\nま、報告だけはしてあげようかな、:
(But the real trouble will be those guys at the Fortress Palace.
Well, I suppose I'll send a report. I am a messenger, after all.)
m920219.（アスガルドも、未来のことを考えないと。\n後ろばかり見ていたら、皆に笑われちゃ:
(Asgard needs to think about the future, too.
If I keep looking back, everyone will laugh at me)
m920219.（ツクヨミめ、これを見せたくて――\n否、共にこの熱を体験させるために、\n我が:
(Tsukuyomi, did you create this small vessel for me
to show me this—
No, to let me share in this passion?)
m920219.（当然よ。だって、見捨てられたんじゃなくて、\n見守ってくれているってことだもの:
(Of course. It means we weren't abandoned.
It means she's watching over us.)
m920219.（昔話に出てくる、空飛ぶお船だね）: (The flying boat from the old stories?)
m920219.（月の神性を持つ子って、性質が似るのかしら？）: (Do children with lunar divinity tend to have similar natures?)
m920219.（記憶、完全に戻ってそうねぇ……）: (It seems her memories have fully returned……)

m930024.……ここまで来ればもう大丈夫かな？: ……If we've made it this far, we should be safe now, right?
m930024.……そうかい、やっぱりシズカを助けてくれたのは君か。: ……I see. So it was you who saved Shizuka after all.
m930024.……帝は会談の申し出を受け入れられる。: ……The Emperor has accepted the proposal for a meeting.
m930024.……汝らも、どこへなりとも行け。: ……You may all go wherever you please.
m930024.──口は禍の元とはよく言ったものよな。: ──"The mouth is the source of disaster," as they say.
m930024.あの御方は幼いが、決して愚かではない。\n正しき道さえ示せれば、名君となられる器:
That one is young, but by no means foolish.
If shown the right path, they have the potential to become a great ruler.
m930024.あまり勘違いをしてくれるなよ、東夷風情が。\nどうして近衛大将たる予が汝らを救わ:
Don't get the wrong idea, you Eastern barbarians.
Why should I, the Grand General of the Imperial Guard, be saving you?
It was merely a measure to keep Douman from growing overconfident.
m930024.あれは私が未熟ゆえの不始末。恨みなどない。: That was my own clumsiness. I hold no grudge.
m930024.ここだけの話、帝は王子に憧れているって話よ。: Between us, the Emperor is said to look up to you, Prince.
m930024.しかし、帝の御父君は──\n先の帝は京を襲った妖怪の手にかかった。\nその怒りが:
However, the Emperor's father──
The previous Emperor fell to the hands of the demons that attacked the capital.
Do not forget that their anger is justified.
m930024.それでも押し通るというのであれば、予を越えてみせよ！: If you intend to press on regardless, then try to get past me!
m930024.だったら要するに敵は同じなんだし、見逃してくれない？: Well, if that's the case, we're fighting the same enemy. Can't you just let us go?
m930024.ではカラスマル殿、お達者で。: Then, Lord Karasumaru, take care of yourself.
m930024.どうした獣、この期にいつぞやの恨みを晴らすか？: What is it, beast? Is this not the chance to settle that old grudge?
m930024.なら、歩きながら今後の流れについて説明しようか。: Then, let me explain the plan of action while we walk.
m930024.ならば疾く失せよ、不愉快だ。貴様の匂いは鼻につく。: Then be gone. You are unpleasant. Your scent gives me a headache.
m930024.ならん、汝は朝廷に対する蛮行を宣言した。: No. You have declared war on the Imperial Court.
m930024.はいはい、ひでぇ言われようだな。: Yeah, yeah, you're really harsh, you know.
m930024.まっ、確かに間違ってはおりませぬが。: Well, you're not entirely wrong, I suppose.
m930024.やあやあシズカ殿、随分と早い再会でしたなぁ！: Oh my, oh my, Lady Shizuka. What a swift reunion!
m930024.よい、予の負けだ。腕が鈍ったな。: Very well. This is my defeat. My skills have grown dull.
m930024.セイメイめ、しくじったら許さぬぞ。: Seimei, don't think I'll forgive you if you fail.
m930024.マサムネに、ムラサメまで……！\n道理で急に姿が見えなくなったわけね。:
Masamune, and even Murasame…!
That's why they suddenly vanished.
m930024.予は夜の散歩中に辻斬りに襲われたのだ。\n負傷して動けず、あの廃寺で一夜を明かす:
I was simply ambushed by a cutpurse on a night walk.
I was injured and unable to move, so I spent the night in that abandoned temple.
The culprit's face was lost in the darkness of the night.
m930024.人間、平和になるほど近くに敵を見出し始めるからさ。: Humans tend to start seeing enemies nearby the more peace they have, you know.
m930024.似たような境遇から世界の英雄に至った存在だからなー。: He's a figure who rose from a similar background to become a hero of the world, after all.
m930024.作戦の決行日はまだ未定だけど、\n当日は二手に分かれて行動する予定。:
The date for the operation hasn't been set yet, but
we intend to split into two groups on the day.
m930024.内裏からの追っ手の気配は皆無かと～。: I can't sense any pursuers from the palace at all~.
m930024.刀が入用だったら呼んでくれ。安くしとく。: If you ever need a blade, just give me a call. I'll knock off the price.
m930024.分かったってもう……また、戦場で。: Got it, got it… See you on the battlefield again.
m930024.受けてくれるかどうかは正直半々だけど、\nドウマンの反対さえなければ大丈夫なはず:
Honestly, it's fifty-fifty whether they'll accept, but
as long as Douman doesn't oppose it, it should be fine.
m930024.受けてもらえた場合はハッタリでいいから強気にね。\nドウマンも今の戦力で王国と事:
If they do accept, be bold, even if it's just a bluff.
Douman surely doesn't want to start a conflict with the kingdom with his current forces.
m930024.帝と離れて陰陽寮に戻る瞬間があいつの最期よ。: The moment he separates from the Emperor and returns to the Yin-Yang Academy is his end.
m930024.帝に仇なす者、その全てが予の敵である。: Anyone who defies the Emperor is my enemy.
m930024.帝の玉体に傷一つでもつけてみろ、予は汝らを殺す。: If you lay a finger on the Emperor's royal person, I will kill you.
m930024.悪いな、大将には世話になってるんでね。: I'm sorry, we've had your help, Commander.
m930024.敗北しておいて見逃すも何もなかろう。: Having just been defeated, there is no "letting go" about it.
m930024.最悪断られたとしても問題はないよ。\n仲裁をしようとした事実は主張できるし、\n:
Even if they refuse in the worst case, it's no problem.
We can claim we attempted to mediate, and
that will change how other nations view us.
m930024.汚名覚悟の王国と全面戦争になった場合、\n朝廷の戦力では抵抗も難しいですからね～:
If it comes to a full-scale war with a kingdom prepared to bear the infamy,
the court's military strength wouldn't be enough to resist~.
m930024.汝らが奴と潰し合うのを期待してのことよ。: I was simply hoping you two would wear each other out.
m930024.王国関連の書物を熱心に集めていたり、\n王子の武勇伝を歌う詩人を呼び寄せたり。\:
He's been fervently collecting books related to the kingdom,
and even inviting poets to sing of your exploits.
Don't let his appearance fool you; His Majesty is quite the enthusiast.
m930024.王子が帝とドウマンを引き付けている隙に、\n私たちが内裏に潜入して暗殺の準備を進:
While you, Prince, keep the Emperor and Douman occupied,
we will infiltrate the palace and prepare for the assassination.
m930024.王子たちは朝廷に改めて会談を申し入れてほしい。\n公家と武家の仲裁って名目で、可:
I want you, Prince, to formally request another audience with the court.
Under the pretext of mediating between the nobles and the warriors, make it as grand as possible.
m930024.王子としては気分が悪い話だろうけど、\n今後はこういう交渉も増えていくと思う。:
It's probably not a pleasant thought for you, Prince, but
I think negotiations like this will become more common going forward.
m930024.用済みだ。予は秩序と安寧を尊ぶ、いかれは要らん。: You are no longer useful to me. I value order and peace; I have no use for madmen.
m930024.薄汚い野鼠どもの戯れに興味はないが、\n御所への狼藉とあらば止めねばなるまい。:
I have no interest in the games of filthy rats, but
if it's an outrage against the palace, I must stop it.
m930024.見逃してくれるのかい？: Are you going to let us go?
